verdict.rationale: The evidence shows only developer building blocks: an API to retrieve call transcriptions, a tutorial on importing recordings and voicemail into your own infrastructure, and generic webhooks. Nothing documents Aircall itself transcribing voicemails and delivering them to email or chat. Building blocks a developer could assemble do not earn credit, so the verdict is none.

support.subject: As a founder, voicemails are transcribed and delivered to email or chat so I can read them without dialing in

citations.quote: Import your recordings and voicemail in your infrastructure and add an extra layer of security.
